decks.notes: The main concept of this UR Aggro deck is to use cheap and efficient spells to disrupt the opponent's game plan while deploying creatures like Murktide Regent and Dragon's Rage Channeler to quickly close out the game. The deck aims to maintain tempo advantage by utilizing cards like Daze and Force of Will to protect its threats and control the board. With a low mana curve and card draw/filtering options like Ponder and Brainstorm, the deck focuses on quickly establishing a threatening board presence and pressuring the opponent's life total.

This deck focuses on disrupting the opponent's strategy while maintaining control of the battlefield. By utilizing a combination of hand disruption spells, removal, and counterspells, the deck aims to keep the opponent on the back foot while developing its own board presence. The inclusion of tempo creatures like Brazen Borrower and Murktide Regent allows for quick and efficient threats to pressure the opponent. The deck's mana base is optimized for consistency and speed, with a focus on disrupting the opponent's resources through cards like Wasteland.

This deck focuses on quickly assembling the Coveted Jewel combo using cards like Transmute Artifact and Grim Monolith. The goal is to generate a large mana advantage, allowing for explosive plays with The One Ring or Emrakul, the Aeons Torn. Control elements like Force of Will and Sink into Stupor help protect the combo pieces, while cards like Show and Tell can help cheat out powerful threats. The deck relies on maximizing mana production and card advantage to overwhelm opponents and win the game in a single explosive turn.

The main concept of this deck is to disrupt the opponent's game plan and tempo while applying pressure with efficient threats. By utilizing disruptive elements like Thoughtseize, Daze, and Force of Will, along with removal spells like Fatal Push, the deck aims to control the game early on. Meanwhile, cards like Murktide Regent and Kaito, Bane of Nightmares provide a clock to close out the game quickly. The deck also incorporates card draw and filtering through Brainstorm, Ponder, and Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student to maintain consistency and adapt to different situations.

The deck focuses on utilizing a combination of disruption spells and efficient creatures to control the game tempo and quickly close out the game. It aims to disrupt the opponent's game plan with cards like Thoughtseize and Force of Will, while also having efficient removal spells like Fatal Push and Go for the Throat. The deck also plays a variety of card draw and selection spells like Brainstorm and Ponder to ensure it has the necessary resources to maintain pressure. Overall, the deck aims to be proactive and aggressive while disrupting the opponent's strategy.

This deck focuses on quickly establishing a board presence and applying pressure with aggressive creatures and burn spells. By utilizing mana acceleration and disruptive cards such as Magus of the Moon, it aims to control the game tempo and prevent opponents from stabilizing. The combination of efficient creatures like Minsc & Boo, along with powerful artifacts like The One Ring, allows for explosive plays and ensures a relentless assault on the opponent. The deck's strategy is to overwhelm the opponent early on and secure victory before they can mount a defense.

The main focus of this deck is to utilize the synergy between Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill the opponent's library for a victory condition. Additionally, the deck includes various support cards like Goblin Engineer, Goblin Welder, and Urza's Saga to tutor for and protect key combo pieces. The inclusion of red elemental spells like Pyroblast and Lightning Bolt provide disruption and removal options while also enabling additional strategies. The deck aims to quickly assemble the combo and disrupt the opponent's game plan to secure a win.

The key concept of this deck is to rapidly set up a powerful combo using Show and Tell to cheat in either Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Atraxa, Grand Unifier onto the battlefield. Utilizing cards like Sneak Attack and Lotus Petal to facilitate this combo, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent with powerful creatures and lock down the game with Force of Will and other control elements. The inclusion of various card draw and manipulation spells like Brainstorm and Ponder helps to ensure consistency in executing the combo.

The main strategy of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures like Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier using cards like Entomb and Reanimate, and then bring them back into play using spells such as Animate Dead. The deck also includes disruption cards like Daze and Force of Will to protect this combo. Additionally, the deck has some versatility with cards like Brazen Borrower and Thoughtseize for additional control and disruption. Overall, the deck aims to efficiently reanimate powerful creatures to overwhelm the opponent.

The main focus of this deck is to quickly fill the graveyard with powerful creatures, such as Archon of Cruelty and Atraxa, Grand Unifier, using cards like Entomb and Thoughtseize. Then, utilizing cards like Animate Dead and Reanimate to bring these creatures back onto the battlefield for a powerful combo. The deck also includes disruption cards like Force of Will and Wasteland to control the game and protect the reanimation strategy. Overall, the goal is to overwhelm the opponent with powerful reanimated creatures and win the game quickly.

The deck revolves around quickly comboing off with Cephalid Illusionist and Nomads en-Kor to mill cards and put Thassa's Oracle or Dread Return into play for a win. It uses Force of Will and Swords to Plowshares for protection and disruption, and utilizes cards like Memory's Journey and Meticulous Archive to ensure the combo goes off smoothly. The deck also includes some utility lands like Urza's Saga and Cavern of Souls to further support the combo strategy. Through careful manipulation and efficient card selection, the deck aims to win the game in a quick and decisive manner.

The deck focuses on controlling the game through counterspells, removal spells, and card draw, with the goal of out-valuing the opponent and establishing a dominant board presence. It utilizes a mix of efficient counterspells like Force of Will and Spell Pierce, along with removal spells like Swords to Plowshares and Prismatic Ending to disrupt the opponent's game plan. Card draw spells like Ponder and Brainstorm help dig for key cards, while Tamiyo, Inquisitive Student provides additional card advantage. Murktide Regent serves as a powerful threat that can close out games quickly. The deck also includes land disruption with Wasteland and Karakas to further control the game.

The deck focuses on quickly getting out either Emrakul, the Aeons Torn or Omniscience onto the battlefield using cards like Show and Tell, Cunning Wish, and Stock Up. By cheating these powerful cards into play early, the deck aims to overwhelm the opponent and win the game in just a few turns. Utilizing a mix of counterspells and card draw spells, the deck aims to protect its key combo pieces while digging for important cards. The deck relies on explosive plays and careful decision making to secure victory.

This Legacy combo deck focuses on using Painter's Servant and Grindstone to mill opponents' libraries quickly. The deck also includes key cards such as Fable of the Mirror-Breaker and Fury to support the combo. With a mix of mana acceleration from cards like Simian Spirit Guide and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to disrupt opponent's strategies by using Red Elemental Blast and Pyroblast to control the board. The inclusion of cards like Abrade and Lightning Bolt provide additional removal and versatility in handling threats. Overall, the deck is built around a powerful and efficient combo strategy.

The main concept of this deck is to quickly ramp up mana using cards like Ancient Tomb and Lotus Petal, while manipulating the hand with Brainstorm and Ponder to find key combo pieces like Show and Tell and Sneak Attack. The deck aims to cheat powerful creatures like Emrakul, the Aeons Torn and Archon of Cruelty into play, often with the help of Omniscience, to overwhelm the opponent and close out the game quickly. Force of Will and Spell Pierce provide protection against disruption, allowing the combo to go off smoothly and efficiently.

This Eldrazi Aggro deck focuses on ramping up quickly to put out powerful creatures like Thought-Knot Seer and Glaring Fleshraker early in the game. The deck also includes disruptive elements like Chalice of the Void to hinder opponents' plays. Utilizing cards like Eldrazi Temple and Ancient Tomb, the deck aims to overwhelm opponents with its aggressive and efficient creatures. The inclusion of cards like The One Ring and Sowing Mycospawn provide additional utility and versatility in different game situations. Overall, the deck aims to establish early dominance and close out games swiftly.
